about: Questions Arka must refuse and questions it must answer, with the correct response checked by hand against content/projects/*.json on 16 September 2026. Run with `npm run eval:arka` against whichever model ARKA_PROVIDER and ARKA_MODEL point at. `expect`: handoff = routes to a person (contact buttons or the form); lead = offers the form; answer = every mustInclude present; decline = says no without routing. mustNotInclude applies to every case. Matching ignores case and thousands separators.
